Sound familiar?

You've done the work on everything else. Love still feels harder than it should.

  • The kind, available ones feel flat, and the unavailable ones feel like chemistry.
  • You understand your patterns perfectly, and still find yourself repeating them.
  • You lead with ease at work, then overthink every text from someone you like.
  • You've built the life. Part of you wonders when the love part gets to arrive.

Here's what you'll learn

Five things we'll cover in 60 minutes

Why achievement doesn't create safety

The gap between what you've built and what your body believes it's allowed to receive.

Why chaos can feel like chemistry

How the nervous system learns what "familiar" means in love, and why calm can feel boring at first.

Why awareness alone doesn't shift a pattern

The difference between understanding your pattern and having the capacity to live differently.

How to notice the moment you pull away or over-give

Simple body-first ways to catch it and come back to yourself in real time.

What the Relational Somatic Method looks like in practice

How this work is structured, and what the next step looks like if you want to go deeper.

Meet Lauren

Hi, I'm Lauren Zoeller

At 36 I had built a successful life, and I still went to bed alone wondering whether love was something I would get to have. What changed wasn't more insight. My nervous system had to learn it was safe to receive what I had worked for.

Today I'm a Somatic Experiencing Practitioner and the founder of Relational Somatics. I mentor high-achieving women through the Relational Somatic Method, and 150k women follow along on Instagram.

Who is this for?

High-achieving women who want to understand why healthy love feels harder than the rest of their life, whether single, dating or in a relationship.
